race.comment: JUST REMEMBER IT (2) progressed nicely last start at the second run of the preparation, finding the line steadily to finish third over 1000m at Mornington. Has a win and a placing from two third-up runs. Needs 1100m now so this looks an ideal set-up. REAL HEIR (9) led all the way to win his maiden two back at Yarra Valley. Didn't jump the best and that was the end of the section in Adelaide last time out. Back in his right race today so watch for a return to form. MAYA'S ACE (10) returns after a 20-week spell. Opened the last prep with a dogged win over 1000m at Cranbourne. Placed in a recent Flemington jump-out so she looks forward enough to make her presence felt. HARRY DE LAD (4) last raced when a maiden winner over 1200m on the Ballarat Synthetic on 26 June. Consistent sprinter who won a recent jump-out so he looks set for a bright return. GIRLS NIGHT (7) has been in the money at three of four first-up runs so she must be respected coming off an 18-week spell.
